upstreamFrontmatter.name: ultimate-browsing
upstreamFrontmatter.description: Reaches web pages the user's browser cannot open: WAF-blocked and bot-scored hosts, platform-native readers (Chinese and social platforms), archive snapshots with provenance, and a browser you own for stealth or throwaway profiles. Not for plain search, an unblocked static fetch, or a page the user's browser can open.

adaptations: Restricted to user-selected local/browser/Obsidian execution; cloud, remote-provider and foreign-runtime branches disabled.
Russian discovery metadata and task-scoped invocation policy; original descriptions retained in upstreamFrontmatter.
